'''David Huberman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Victorian State Championship]] in May 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down with TIE Defenders]], according to Michael Josem's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d797">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-23-b-victorian-state-championships-bd797/ b-victorian-state-championships-b], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 23 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-23-b-victorian-state-championships-bd797/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
